brief:
Four imprisoned activists from Palestine Action are appealing convictions for criminal damage that courts linked to terrorism, Al Jazeera English reported. The group has faced legal charges connected to direct-action campaigns against companies it says support Israeli military operations. The appeals represent a continued legal battle over how British courts classify protest-related property damage.

Palestine Action has conducted disruptive demonstrations at factory sites and corporate offices in the United Kingdom. The convictions have drawn scrutiny over the application of terrorism-related charges to protest activities, raising questions about the scope of Britain's counterterrorism framework.
dek: Palestine Action activists convicted of criminal damage “with a terrorist connection” are appealing their convictions.
title: Four Palestine Action activists appeal terrorism-linked convictions
